notes.title: Lost Lands on Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
[p]Hello there![/p][p][/p][p]We are a two person team here in Hungry Trolls and we are happy to finally get a demo of Lost Lands into [b]your[/b] hands. 
[/p][p]It was founded on one core philosophy - discovery. We wanted a game in which players can learn about the rules of the world they are in as they play it. No hand holding, tutorial will explain the basics, and the rest is up to you. 
[/p][p]We also wanted a game that is as much stress-free (got enough of that in our daily lives, don’t we) as possible - no battles, no calamities. You cannot lose the game. Kick back and take it easy.
[/p][p]The Demo is limited to the first three seasons in the game, which translates to roughly 45 minutes of gameplay and should give you a rough impression about what to expect from the full release.
[/p][p]If you are looking to connect with us, here is a bunch of ways of doing it:

1. [url="https://discord.gg/hUCKp8zp"]Discord server [/url]- if you want to follow the development, leave feedback and chat with us;[/p][p]2. [url="https://bsky.app/profile/hungrytrolls.bsky.social"]Bluesky profile[/url] - if you want to only follow the development;[/p][p]3. info\[at][url="https://hungrytrolls.com"]hungrytrolls.com[/url] - in case the other approaches sound too personal;[/p][p] [/p][p]And remember - leave us a review, it helps us massively <3[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you enjoy your stay!
[/p][p]Very Hungry Trolls.[/p]
